# H2 2.4.240 LOB snapshot coordination patch

This is an explicit, MPL-2.0-licensed source patch to two H2 classes, not another persistence model. Application/domain code remains in `org.nonprofitbookkeeping`; the vendored classes necessarily retain H2's binary package and nested types. Maven/Eclipse compile it into the application output, ahead of the unmodified H2 dependency. The application JAR must precede dependencies on a manually assembled classpath. The non-modular JavaFX launcher explicitly uses CLASSPATH so the patch and dependency share a loader. Native backup fails closed if the patch marker is absent or the runtime engine differs from 2.4.240.

Upstream source: Maven Central `com.h2database:h2:2.4.240:sources`, `org/h2/mvstore/db/LobStorageMap.java`. Original file SHA-256: `30c23fa55ab22830209f5b5672b80ca5e058170867fbb135a7d629e8dd2d3979`. The original copyright and dual-license notice remain intact; this modified file is distributed under MPL 2.0 (see LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt). Complete modified source is in `src/main/java/org/h2/mvstore/db/LobStorageMap.java`; `LobStorageMap.patch` shows the changes against upstream. MVStore.java is also patched from that exact source artifact (original SHA-256 `3779b539f0921830efe92a6ab073b6b7495505f18b759472fe01e69a437d004d`); its modified source is src/main/java/org/h2/mvstore/MVStore.java and its review diff is vendor/h2/MVStore.patch. The upstream dependency and native file format remain 2.4.240.

LOB creation/copy/removal operations acquire Database.getLobSyncObject; the application takes that same monitor before committing/draining/copying the native file. Related LOB metadata/reference changes additionally use MVStore.executeAtomicMapUpdate under the existing store/checkpoint lock. Reentrant automatic checkpoints are deferred until the outermost successful group completes. This also protects cleanup in reopened/restored databases; a backup-only monitor was insufficient. Streaming payload allocation remains incremental outside the atomic metadata group, so a large Reader does not pin all of its bytes in memory until completion. Markers identify both components as patch level 1. No maps/records are reconstructed, no private fields reflected, and no user transaction is closed, committed or rolled back by backup. Upstream source style is retained to make the vendor diff auditable. The atomic helper is a checkpoint boundary, not a SQL transaction or rollback implementation. Original engine exception semantics and assertions remain.

Do not change the H2 dependency without reviewing/rebasing this patch and rerunning the pinned-runtime, parameter-stream barrier, complete native/concurrent/legacy recovery and packaged-classpath tests. Do not remove synchronization or assertions to hide a failed backup. Governing rationale and evidence: doc/P27-C7-h2-lob-coordination.md.

The review patches use zero context; use `git apply --unidiff-zero` when applying them to the exact upstream source. License text has only trailing whitespace normalized.
